summary: Interpreted the session eviction probe. Receipt 3b8c9b4234024ebfb8b1cc54dd722e26 passed with three events: clients 22 and 33 were kept with their stored responses while client 11, added first and looked up right after, was evicted with no stored value, which is least-recently-used behavior at capacity two. Combined with the state machine's missing-session branch, an evicted client's retry is rejected rather than re-applied, so eviction costs availability but does not allow a duplicate update. Marked the investigation explained with defect_claim refuted, promoted the eviction outcome to knowledge, and kept the lrusession-only scope and single capacity as limits.
